# Growperty

> Greater Noida's property platform — buy, sell, and get WhatsApp alerts for residential and commercial real estate in Greater Noida and the YEIDA (Yamuna Expressway) corridor.

## About

Growperty is a real estate marketplace focused on Greater Noida and surrounding regions. It connects property buyers, sellers, and channel partners directly — no broker fees on buyer side.

- Platform URL: https://growperty.com
- Company: Grenoverse Multi Ventures LLP
- Contact: https://growperty.com/contact

## Key Sections

- [All Properties](https://growperty.com/properties) — Browse approved listings filtered by BHK, type, price, sector
- [Fast Track](https://growperty.com/fast-track) — Shortlisted premium properties, quick decision listings
- [Projects](https://growperty.com/projects) — New launch and under-construction projects
- [Post Requirement](https://growperty.com/post-requirement) — Buyers describe what they need; get matched listings via WhatsApp
- [List Property](https://growperty.com/list-property) — Sellers submit their property; reviewed and published within 24 hours
- [Become Channel Partner](https://growperty.com/become-channel-partner) — Real estate agents join as channel partners
- [Area Guide — Greater Noida](https://growperty.com/area-guide/greater-noida) — Sector-level breakdown of localities, connectivity, price trends
- [Area Guide — YEIDA](https://growperty.com/area-guide/yeida)
- [Blog](https://growperty.com/blog)
- [FAQ](https://growperty.com/faq)

## Property Types Supported

Flat/Apartment, Independent House, Villa, Penthouse, Plot/Land, Commercial

## Geographic Focus

Currently live: Greater Noida (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, Zeta, Eta sectors, Knowledge Park) and Yamuna Expressway (YEIDA). Coming soon: Noida, Greater Noida West and the wider Delhi-NCR.

## How It Works

1. Buyer posts a requirement or browses listings
2. Seller lists a property (free, reviewed within 24 hrs)
3. Buyer requests a visit via the platform
4. Seller confirms visit time
5. Both parties receive WhatsApp confirmation
6. Deal is tracked to closure

## Data / API

- Property listings are publicly viewable at `/property/:id`
- Sitemap: https://growperty.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://growperty.com/robots.txt
